title: dactylorhiza richteri
intro: Dactylorhiza richteri, commonly known as the Red Helleborine, is a species of flowering plant in the orchid family (Orchidaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, as well as its ability to support respiratory health and immune function. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorhiza richteri include its ability to calm inflammation, soothe respiratory issues, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
